أتمايل (form VI)
# أَتَمَايَلُ (ʔatamāyalu) /ʔa.ta.maː.ja.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# أَتَمَايَلَ (ʔatamāyala) /ʔa.ta.maː.ja.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
# أَتَمَايَلْ (ʔatamāyal) /ʔa.ta.maː.jal/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَمَايَلَ (tamāyala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
